name: release
text:
Immigration programs › Review and release
Review and release

Everyone's changes are in one shared draft. Releasing publishes together every combination that has passed its review (submitted, and signed by the content reviewer where an expert must sign); firms keep what was approved until then. Last release: Release 1, Oct 28, 2026.

Nothing to release

The shared draft has no changes since the last release. Changes appear here as soon as someone edits a combination.
